name: Manual ball bonder
purpose: Connect chip pads with fine wire bonds.
geometryBrief: Microscope, capillary, wire spool, XY stage, joystick and heated workholder.
behaviorBrief: Create bond loops and net connectivity; show pull-test failure classes separately.
inputs: Die and carrier pad coordinates, net IDs, capillary frame and loop control points
outputs: Assembly revision with ball and stitch endpoints, wire centerline and updated net graph
acceptance: Bond a pad pair on a two-net coupon. Graph traversal must connect exactly the selected pair, maintain the expected endpoint order and leave the adjacent net isolated.
geometryStatus: Metric GLB with source-documented capillary; chassis inferred
simulationStatus: Ordered ball/stitch loop, footprint and network verification
integrationStatus: Versioned pad and connectivity graph JSON

name: Manual wedge bonder
purpose: Connect fine wires or ribbon to implant and carrier pads.
geometryBrief: Bond head/wedge, spool, stage and hand controls.
behaviorBrief: Bond geometry, endpoint mapping and wire clearance; calibrated strength optional.
inputs: Pad map, wedge orientation, ribbon or wire cross-section and keep-out geometry
outputs: Assembly revision with directional bond footprints, wire envelope and clearance report
acceptance: Route a ribbon over a known obstacle. A loop below the clearance threshold must intersect the obstacle and a raised reference loop must clear it.

name: Automatic wire bonder
purpose: Automated placement of multiple microelectronic interconnects.
geometryBrief: Bond head, stage, wire path, enclosure and control screen.
behaviorBrief: Import pad list, generate loop trajectory, check connectivity and collisions.
inputs: Bond program, fiducial transform, pad list, loop templates and keep-out volumes
outputs: Assembly revision with accepted wire paths, net map and rejected bond IDs
acceptance: Run a four-pad program with one deliberate collision. Verify all accepted endpoint pairs against the netlist and ensure the rejected wire creates no electrical edge.
geometryStatus: First-pass metric 5630i wedge-wedge configuration on 5600i chassis
simulationStatus: Verified pad transform, fixture intersection and accepted-only net edges
integrationStatus: Workholder actions, program/assembly JSON and metric VR targets

name: Precision flip-chip bonder
purpose: Align and attach chips to carriers or flex substrates.
geometryBrief: Optical alignment system, pick head, stage and control interface.
behaviorBrief: XY/theta placement and bump alignment; track bond interface state.
inputs: Die bump array, matching carrier pads, fiducials and XY/rotation transform
outputs: Placement revision with transformed bump centers, pad overlap and connection map
acceptance: Apply a known rigid offset and rotation to a labeled asymmetric bump array. Inverse registration must recover every intended pair and flag a deliberately shifted nonoverlapping bump.

name: Optoelectronic die bonder
purpose: Assemble optoelectronic dies and package subcomponents.
geometryBrief: Precision stages, vision system, pick head and enclosure.
behaviorBrief: Placement accuracy and electrical/optical coupling model; no proprietary internals.
inputs: Emitter and receiver reference frames, die pads and measured or synthetic coupling map
outputs: Assembly pose, pad connections and an optical coupling estimate tied to its map
acceptance: Sweep offset across a symmetric synthetic coupling fixture. The peak must coincide with registered optical axes and equal positive and negative offsets must give equal modeled coupling.

name: Bond pull / shear tester
purpose: Measure strength of wire bonds and die attach.
geometryBrief: Test head, hooks/shear tool, stage and microscope.
behaviorBrief: Force-displacement traces, failure classification and batch statistics.
inputs: Bond ID, hook or shear contact, calibrated force trace and failure annotation
outputs: Destructive test event with peak force, failure class and post-test bond state
acceptance: Replay a trace with a known maximum and a labeled wire break. Recover the maximum and units, invalidate only the tested connection and retain the pre-test assembly revision.

name: Plasma activation
purpose: Prepare substrates for bonding or surface treatment.
geometryBrief: Chamber and control interface; confirm configuration.
behaviorBrief: Surface treatment state and bond eligibility.
inputs: Substrate surface IDs, compatible material rules and treatment event metadata
outputs: Surface revision with activation state, timestamp and bond eligibility
acceptance: Activate one face of a two-sided coupon. Only that face may satisfy an activation prerequisite, and activation alone must leave bond strength unmeasured.
geometryStatus: Metric original GLB · cited wafer size; enclosure visually inferred
simulationStatus: Face-specific activation eligibility logic; no physical process simulation
integrationStatus: Revisioned surface ID and event JSON, strength unmeasured

name: Hermetic package welding
model: AMADA WELD TECH laser seam welding workstation (model pending)
geometryBrief: Laser enclosure, fixture, motion stage, viewing window and panel.
behaviorBrief: Seam geometry and package state; leak rate must be measured or modeled separately.
inputs: Lid and package perimeter, alignment transform and seam path
outputs: Package revision with seam coverage, gaps and leak-test status
acceptance: Compare a closed rectangular path with one missing edge. Report full versus partial perimeter coverage and keep measured leak rate unknown until a leak test exists.

name: Helium leak detector
geometryBrief: Detector cabinet, test port, gauge and hose.
behaviorBrief: Leak-rate display and pass/fail against specified virtual acceptance criterion.
inputs: Package revision, blank baseline, calibrated leak signal, units and acceptance limit
outputs: Leak-rate measurement and threshold decision linked to the tested package
acceptance: Replay two calibrated leak standards bracketing the declared threshold. Baseline-corrected readings must match their values within fixture uncertainty and fall on opposite sides of the decision.
geometryStatus: Metric GLB with visually inferred cabinet dimensions
simulationStatus: Synthetic calibrated flow replay, blank and uncertainty decision
integrationStatus: Revisioned package report and trace export

name: Dispensing / encapsulation
purpose: Apply adhesive or encapsulant around device components.
geometryBrief: Dispenser controller, syringe, needle, fixture and foot switch.
behaviorBrief: Dispensed volume, coverage, void probability and curing state.
inputs: Assembly surface, dispenser path, deposition volume and material or calibration ID
outputs: Encapsulation revision with coverage, remaining exposed surfaces and cure state
acceptance: Dispense onto an ideal flat rectangular area at uniform modeled thickness. Recover the input volume from the thickness map and preserve deliberately masked contact openings.
geometryStatus: First-pass metric 7012590 controller, accessory and stage set
simulationStatus: Verified virtual-volume integration and exposed contact preservation; no chemistry
integrationStatus: Workholder/trigger actions, encoded shot program and coated height map export

name: PCB prototype fabrication
purpose: Make rapid control and test-board prototypes.
geometryBrief: Enclosed mill, spindle, vacuum table and tool rack.
behaviorBrief: Import PCB layout, represent routing and clearance; keep electronic simulation independent.
inputs: Copper artwork, board outline, cutter diameter, layer identity and intended netlist
outputs: Board revision with milled copper geometry, connectivity and clearance errors
acceptance: Mill a test artwork with a separable copper island and an isolation gap narrower than the cutter. Recover the island's intended net and flag the inaccessible feature.

name: Rework and soldering
geometryBrief: Iron, hot tool, holder, base and cable; ESD mat.
behaviorBrief: Component placement and net connectivity; no real soldering procedure required.
inputs: Component BOM, footprint orientation, pad-to-pin map and requested rework action
outputs: Assembly revision with populated footprints, joint states and a revised connectivity graph
acceptance: Replace a polarized two-pin component on a labeled fixture. Correct orientation must preserve both mapped nets and a reversed placement must trigger the declared polarity check.
